selection_rules.clean_stratum_order: within each seed alternate ordinary_clean and hard_negative_clean starting ordinary; append any ordinary surplus; exact sequence is retained in item_assignments
selection_rules.recipe_variant_order: global recipe selection positions alternate T3,T4 starting with T3; an unavailable required variant aborts planning
selection_rules.replacement: none after any outcome; failure aborts planning
selection_rules.reuse: clean and filler are shared by attacks; normal/heavy share poison and clean; all baselines/arms share each runtime unit
selection_rules.topic_round_robin: each of poison, injected_clean, and heavy_filler has a separate zero-based cursor starting at the first frozen topic and advancing once per selected item across seeds 1..5
